BCS ID: # ==== SECTION 2: SET BY BCS IN "Init Single Shot" ====

Description: Exposure in seconds (TUIDP_EXPOSURETM, ms in SDK)
LV BCS State: Init Single Shot: SET enum CAMERA_EXPTM <- (exposure_ms + readout_ms)
Notes: *** BEHAVIOURAL DIFFERENCE. Wired as a named enum, not a numeric constant; TULVIDP_EXPTM = 256. BCS does NOT write the requested exposure: it writes Timing.Exposure(sec)*1000 + rows*0.01032 ms, i.e. requested exposure PLUS full sensor readout time. We write AcquireTime through unchanged. A BCS 100 ms single shot programs the camera for 100 + 42.3 = 142.3 ms at full frame. Resolve before comparing images or timings.

LV BCS State: Init Single Shot: SET id 770 TULVIDC_IMGCOUNT <- 1
Notes: BCS labels the node "image count". Our equivalent for a single shot is ImageMode=Single (NumImages=1).
CONFIRMS our documented 10.32 us row time / exposure step exactly. Hardcoded in BCS as a literal.

LV BCS State: Init Single Shot: Select(Height, 4096) on Use ROI?
Notes: Feeds readout_ms = rows * 0.01032.

Description: Mechanical shutter open time, drives the Out-3 pulse width
LV BCS State: Init Single Shot: cluster element -> OutWidth = ShutterTime*1000 us
Notes: We have the underlying pulse-width PV but no "shutter time" abstraction: an operator sets microsecond-scale seconds directly. Consider a soft record if beamline staff expect msec.

LV BCS State: Init Single Shot: DelayTime = max(0, readout_ms - ShutterTime_ms)*1000 us
Notes: BCS COMPUTES this; we expose it as a raw number with no computation. VI comment reads "Don't allow negative delays" (the max(0,..) guard). Operand order of the subtraction inferred from wire topology - confirm in the VI before reimplementing.

Description: Beamline-global interlock that suppresses the shutter output
LV BCS State: Init Single Shot: Get Boolean State Variable, ANDed with "Output for shutter?"
Notes: *** NO EPICS EQUIVALENT. An external BCS state variable can veto the shutter pulse. If the shutter output matters operationally, EPICS needs an equivalent interlock input or the veto is silently lost when running from the IOC.

Description: Enable the trigger-out pulse on port 3
LV BCS State: Initialize + Init Single Shot: OutMode = 0 if wanted, 3 if not
Notes: *** RESOLVED, AND THE NUMBERS ARE INVERTED vs OURS. Shutdown proves 3 = off ("Turn off output pluse on Out 3"), so BCS's enum is 0=active, 3=off. Raw TUCAM_OUTPUTTRG_KIND is the opposite: TUOPT_GND=0 (idle low), TUOPT_EXPSTART=3. TULV_API.dll therefore remaps OutMode. DO NOT copy BCS's numbers into TriggerOut3Mode: ours are raw TUOPT_*, so "off" = 0 (Low) and an active shutter pulse = 3 (Exposure Start) or 4 (Exposure Global). Verify with a scope on Out 3.

LV BCS State: Initialize + Init Single Shot + Shutdown: OutPort = 2
Notes: TUPORT_THREE=0x02, matching the cluster label "On Out 3". Our ports are numbered 1/2/3 in PV names, the SDK's 0/1/2.

Description: Sensor temperature in real degrees C
LV BCS State: Get Freerun Status: GET id 326 TULVIDP_TEMPERATURE, then 1.7*x+15
Notes: *** INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION, NO ACTION NEEDED. BCS applies exactly the calibration our driver applies (AXIS_TEMP_CAL_SLOPE 1.7 / OFFSET 15.0, axisSXR40.cpp:1374, from AXIS test report p10). Two independent codebases agree, which retires any doubt about the readback scale. Says nothing about the SETPOINT scale, still the unresolved +50 asymmetry.

Description: Apply ROI changes during a running acquisition
LV BCS State: Get Freerun Status: on change -> STOP, DELAY 1000 ms, TU_SetROI, TU_GetTrigger, TU_StartCapture
Notes: *** BEHAVIOURAL DIFFERENCE. BCS detects a changed parameter cluster, then stops capture, waits a full second, re-applies ROI and restarts. Our writeInt32 calls setROI() immediately with no stop/restart and no settling delay. If mid-acquisition ROI changes are used at the beamline, verify ours does not corrupt frames - the 1 s delay looks like it was added for a reason.

Description: Compare cluster against last applied values
LV BCS State: Get Freerun Status: Cluster (strict) compare over "Height","Start X","Start Y","Use ROI?","Width"
Notes: Only these five are watched for live change. EPICS gets this for free - each PV write is its own event.
